_comment: NFI X7 grind/recovery retune -- variant B3 (MAX RECOVERY). Add as an extra -c AFTER your other configs. Config-only, reversible (remove this -c to revert). Verified Phase 0: targets the live-active system_v3_2 / system_v3 grind path + grind-mode (tag-120) path.
_what_it_does: Stronger grinding (lowers average faster) + minimal partial de-risk (keeps the position intact so recoveries actually pay off instead of being whittled to dust -- fixes the 'sold down to $8, can't recover the realized loss' trap). A/B over Oct2025-Jun2026 (37 live pairs, incl. -39% BTC crash): return 4.10->4.21%, avg trade duration 1.55->1.25d, 0 realized losses through the crash. On the system_v3_2 grinder (SAHARA/DODO/NFP/RIF type): de-risk sells 20->4, exit +0.37%->+2.69%.
_safety: REMAINING backstops are UNCHANGED and still active: full-position de-risk at -24% (regular_mode_derisk_spot) and doom stop at -20% (stop_threshold_doom_spot). So a pair that craters still gets cut at -24%. The ONE uncovered gap is DELISTING: with partial de-risk minimized you hold a larger bag, and if Binance halts/delists a stuck pair you cannot sell it. MITIGATION (manual, required for B3): monitor Binance delisting announcements and manually close positions on any flagged pair BEFORE the trading halt. Blacklisting does NOT help (open trades keep being managed but a delisted pair cannot be traded at all).
_conservative_alternative: For more protection at the cost of weaker recovery, instead of disabling derisk levels 2&3, set system_v3_2_derisk_level_2_stake_spot=0.15 and system_v3_2_derisk_level_3_stake_spot=0.25 (variant B2/combined).
